default_model_policy.required_comparison: Always report symmetric-minus-independent prediction error and parameter reduction.

evaluation.leave_one_epoch_out: Train on two complete sweep repeats and test the third. This measures correction accuracy for known frequency/gain cells.
evaluation.leave_one_frequency_out: Train without one frequency and test that frequency. Only models without a frequency lookup table are eligible.
evaluation.leave_one_radio_out: Fit a strict universal model on one radio and predict the other with no radio-specific baseline adjustment.

frequency_scaling_structure.interpretation: The best rank-k values are optimistic low-rank summaries of the exact-frequency symmetric LUTs. Forced-frequency scaling uses H(f,g)=(f/GHz)*G(g). Explained LUT energy is descriptive and is not a substitute for held-out phase-prediction error.

held_out_gain_pair_comparison.reason: configuration contains no held-out gain pairs

identifiability: Differential phase identifies only RX1 delay minus RX2 delay. Reported branch-delay LUT terms are relative contributions under the stated reference constraints, not absolute physical delays.

branch_gain_delay_lut_per_radio.formula: phase = intercept + RX1_phase[g1] + RX2_phase[g2] - 2*pi*(f-f_ref)*(delay0 + RX1_delay[g1] + RX2_delay[g2])
branch_gain_delay_lut_per_radio.label: Gain-dependent branch-delay LUT per radio

branch_gain_delay_lut_universal.formula: phase = intercept + RX1_phase[g1] + RX2_phase[g2] - 2*pi*(f-f_ref)*(delay0 + RX1_delay[g1] + RX2_delay[g2])
branch_gain_delay_lut_universal.label: Strict universal gain-dependent delay LUT

delay_additive_gain_per_radio.label: One delay + additive gain LUT per radio

frequency_lut_additive_gain_per_radio.label: Frequency LUT + additive gain LUT per radio

frequency_lut_frequency_scaled_symmetric.label: Frequency LUT + f-scaled symmetric gain LUT per radio

frequency_lut_gain_table_frequency_scale.label: Frequency LUT + gain-table-specific f-scaled symmetric gain LUT per radio

frequency_lut_gain_table_symmetric_gain_.label: Frequency LUT + gain-table-specific symmetric gain LUT per radio

frequency_lut_linear_gain_per_radio.label: Frequency LUT + linear gains per radio

frequency_lut_symmetric_gain_per_radio.label: Frequency LUT + symmetric gain LUT per radio

frequency_specific_additive_gain_per_rad.label: Per-frequency additive gain LUT per radio

frequency_specific_antisymmetric_gain_pe.label: Per-frequency antisymmetric gain LUT per radio

symmetric_vs_independent.interpretation: H is one physical gain-response LUT whose contribution is antisymmetric under the RX1-minus-RX2 phase convention. Always fit both H and independent A/B, and report H-minus-A/B error.
